toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jou nee tel ook' and 'jy mag jouself wees' each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS comma belongs before 'en'.

toegepas.blok: Veilig is nie dieselfde as goed nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: With a sentence in between, 'hierdie vraag' does not clearly point to the safe/unsafe question.

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die tweede vraag' points unambiguously to the safe/unsafe question named second, without changing what is said.

toegepas.blok: Veilig is nie dieselfde as goed nie
toegepas.voor: as iemand vra dat jy 'n geheim vir altyd vir jou grootmens wegsteek
toegepas.na: as iemand jou vra om 'n geheim vir altyd vir jou grootmens weg te steek
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'iemand vra jou om ... weg te steek' is the natural construction and matches the glossary; the protected words stay.
toegepas.fout: 'iemand vra dat jy ... wegsteek' is stiff where Afrikaans naturally says 'iemand vra jou om ... weg te steek'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same person, same request, same danger sign; the protected 'n geheim vir altyd' stays and the sentence now matches the glossary wording.

toegepas.na: al sê hy dat hy jou ouers ken

toegepas.rede_keurder: A 'dat' clause reads smoothly and says exactly the same thing; the protected 'al vra hy jou om hulp' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Wat jy nie vir 'n vreemdeling doen nie
toegepas.voor: wat na jou kyk daarvan weet
toegepas.na: wat na jou kyk, daarvan weet
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma where the verb of the relative clause meets the main verb ('kyk, ... weet') makes it easier to read.
toegepas.fout: The embedded relative clause runs straight into the main verb ('kyk daarvan weet'), which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma after the embedded relative clause is standard Afrikaans punctuation and the words are unchanged.

toegepas.voor: hoe lief jy vir daardie mens is
toegepas.na: hoe lief jy ook al vir daardie mens is
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'ook al' the clause does not carry the intended concessive meaning ('no matter how much you love them').
toegepas.fout: Without 'ook al' the clause does not carry its concessive meaning and reads as a fragment.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hoe lief jy ook al vir daardie mens is' states the intended 'no matter how much you love them' without adding anything.

toegepas.blok: As iets nie veilig voel nie

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma sits after the protected 'Dit is nooit jou skuld nie' and leaves it intact; punctuation only.

toegepas.blok: Wat 'n goeie en veilige verhouding jou gee
toegepas.voor: Jy leer iets by die ander.
toegepas.na: Jy leer iets by die ander mens.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die ander' on its own is vague and reads as unfinished.
toegepas.fout: 'by die ander' on its own reads as unfinished and could be taken as 'the others'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die ander mens' completes the phrase and matches the lesson's own definition of a relationship between you and another person.

toegepas.blok: Wat 'n goeie en veilige verhouding jou gee
toegepas.na: vir wie jy dit kan sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sê' needs an object here ('dit') to make a complete clause.
toegepas.fout: 'vir wie jy kan sê' leaves 'sê' without its object and reads elliptically.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'dit' completes the clause without changing who is told or when.

vlae.teks: Elkeen van hierdie tekens is op sy eie genoeg, ook al voel die verhouding lekker.
vlae.rede: 'genoeg' does not say enough for what (presumably to make the relationship unsafe); spelling that out would add words to a definition, so it is left for a person or the writer.

vlae.blok: Veilig is nie dieselfde as goed nie
vlae.rede: Strictly, a gift is not 'told'; what is told later is the surprise or secret about the gift. 'later vertel' is protected, so I have not changed it; the writer may want to look at the subject of the sentence.
